description:
The Firefly All Road is all about versatility. It’s our answer to the search for one bike to do it all.

There are two big keys to that versatility. One is adding tire clearance while preserving as much speed as possible. Technology like our proprietary 3D-printed chainstay yoke, remarkably stiff UDH dropouts, adaptive tube butting, and Ti fork, make us extremely good at achieving that goal.
What distinguishes a Firefly All Road even more, though, is our custom process. Unlike a stock all road bike, our bikes are fully custom, including the geometry, tubing, frame options, finish, and components. You might want it to fit like your road racing bike, or you might want a fit that’s more comfort-oriented. You might want it to have quick steering that’s just stable enough to still feel at home on dirt, or you might want more stability to give yourself a little boost of confidence on loose descents.

Build it with options frame bag mounts, fender mounts, rack mounts, and dynamo light wire routing and you can have a single bike that can be loaded up for bikepacking or stripped down for fast days. Or leave all of those options off and make it look and feel like a pure race bike that just happens to fit bigger tires.

We could go on about ride quality and finish and components, but we’ll save that for when you order your All Road and we get to learn exactly how you want to use it, and how we can build the perfect bike to match.

(A note about the model name: the All Road model used to be our Road Plus model. We updated the model name to better fit modern model name conventions.)

Ideal terrain: Good roads, bad roads, dirt roads, gravel roads, fire roads

components.description: Whisky No.9 RD+ or Enve All-Road carbon fork
